items.topic: Migrate judo-blueprint from Claude Code to pi, with new judo CLI syntax
items.fact: Operator: 'we migrate to pi', 'we have new cli also with new syntax so we will do this with that and we have better models'. Plan: refactor/restructure/update the repo; this session was analysis only (explore mode, no writes). Proposed phases: A pi migration, B new CLI + CONVENTIONS.md + model.md rewrite gated by tests/test-blueprint-mutations.sh, C catalog restructure, D consumption docs, E re-collect with stronger models.

items.topic: Claude-specific constructs to replace for pi
items.claim: Repo uses $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (61 uses in .claude/commands and agents), Task tool subagent_type (12 refs), run_in_background (5), AskUserQuestion, TaskCreate/Update/List/Get, '@agent-docs/...' preload lines
items.fact: pi mapping: no CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (use relative path or a wrapper such as bin/judo); .claude/commands -> .pi/prompts/<name>.md ($ARGUMENTS, $1, $@ work; allowed-tools has no effect); .claude/agents -> .pi/agents/<type>.md via Agent tool with model '@role', or .pi/flows/agents + a flow for parallel per-project fan-out; '@agent-docs/' preload lines are not expanded in pi -> use kb_get/kb_search or explicit reads; docwriter skill (~3k lines, PostToolUse hook, ~/.claude transcript paths) is fully Claude-specific -> drop; AskUserQuestion -> ask_user; Task* tools -> drop or flow state; .claude/judo-cli.jar -> move (e.g. tools/judo-cli.jar), CI already honours JUDO_CLI_JAR.

items.topic: judo-cli invocation is copy-pasted; needs a wrapper
items.claim: Analyzers embed 'java -jar $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/judo-cli.jar -m <model> [-q] graphql <query>' dozens of times, with -q in varying positions
items.fact: Define the CLI call in one wrapper script. Also model-blueprints/*/model.md contains ~1169 lines of GraphQL detection queries/creation mutations, and model-blueprints/CONVENTIONS.md (Input Container Pattern, create(input:{...}){success fqn}, allowed input types) targets the old CLI and must be rewritten; bulk model.md migration gated by tests/test-blueprint-mutations.sh (replays mutations against Sandbox model; uses JUDO_CLI_JAR, default .claude/judo-cli.jar; download via 'mvn validate -P download-model-cli'; CI wired).

PROJECTS.md (21 repos) -> /collect-best-practices [model|backend|frontend] and /collect-model-blueprints; check-project-versions.sh compares remote HEAD SHA vs PROGRESS.md; shallow clone to /tmp/judo-projects/

; 3 analyzers per project (judo-{model,backend,frontend}-analyzer -> best-practices//*.md, 71/74/77 patterns; judo-*-blueprint-analyzer -> model-blueprints//{BLUEPRINT,model,backend,frontend}.md, 105 entries); score-best-practices.py/score-model-blueprints.py/rank-*.py; query-catalog.py list|describe|search|get. Suggest turning collection into a pi flow (deterministic per-project fan-out, resumable).

items.topic: Consuming blueprint catalog from other projects via kb git source
items.fact: pi-dashboard-kb supports SourceConfig {kind: filesystem|npm|git|https, ref, priority, subdir, pin, refresh: on-index|manual|{ttlMs}}. A consumer project adds in .pi/dashboard/knowledge_base.json e.g. {kind:'git', ref:'git@github.com:BlackBeltTechnology/judo-blueprint.git', pin:'develop' or tag, subdir:'model-blueprints', priority:-5, refresh:{ttlMs:86400000}}, repeated per subdir (best-practices, agent-docs); clone cache shared (kind+ref+pin, inferred). Constraints: trust-on-first-use (first kb index must be interactive, else KbUntrustedSourceError, background reindex fails); SSH key needed for private repo; include/exclude are global to the config not per source so subdir is the only way to exclude .claude/ and PROGRESS.md; kb_search tool has no per-source filter (CLI has --root id).

Proposed: put consumable content under one root catalog/{best-practices,model-blueprints,agent-docs} so one git source+subdir covers it; add kb-understood frontmatter (description, keywords, tags like domain:model, layer:backend, project:rackinspect); real DOX AGENTS.md per catalog dir (kb dox init) so each blueprint is a one-line row in the agents lane; tag releases (blueprints-vN) for pin. Proposed only, operator had not yet confirmed.

items.topic: kb frontmatter keys: only title/description/aliases/keywords searchable; facets tags,status,author,category,date
items.claim: Blueprint frontmatter (id, domain, category, score, usage_count, alternative_count, projects, first_seen, last_updated) is assumed queryable
items.fact: kb DEFAULT_SEARCHABLE_KEYS = title, description, aliases, keywords; DEFAULT_FACET_KEYS = tags, status, author, category, date(date type). Score/projects/id/domain are invisible to kb; the engine supports Filter{key,op eq|in|gte|lte} but the kb_search tool doesn't expose facet filters, so query-catalog.py remains the only structured query tool.

items.topic: Empty root AGENTS.md template pollutes kb agents lane
items.claim: Root AGENTS.md contains only a placeholder 'Project Overview' comment
items.fact: It ranked #2 in the agents lane for 'audit log entity blueprint' with no content; fill it or remove it. Also .claude/** (docwriter hooks-reference.md etc.) is indexed and ranks first for generic queries; exclude .claude/**, **/PROGRESS.md, **/__pycache__/** in .pi/dashboard/knowledge_base.json.

.pi/dashboard/kb/index.db* (~18MB) is untracked-not-ignored and .pi/ is untracked: gitignore .pi/dashboard/kb/ to avoid committing it (kb init does this for project configs; custom dbPath needs manual entry). After moves/renames run 'kb index --force'; verdicts flag MOVED/GONE.

items.topic: kb CLI not on PATH; how to run manually; git scope works
items.fact: 'kb' not on PATH; pi tools kb_search/kb_get/kb_neighbors reindex automatically. For manual runs use npx @blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-kb or bin/kb.mjs in the dashboard checkout. kb init/index/search flags: --source, --db, --force, --refresh, --doc-type doc|agents|source-md, --root id. kb_search scope:'git' (commits/PRs/issues) works on this repo by default, forge synced via gh. 'No sources[] -> kb index exits 2'. DOX doctrine unconfigured causes a prompt (kb read / read+write / off). The kb guard warns after 3 consecutive source searches without kb_search.
